text: Cathodic protection of the seawater intake structure, pump house metalwork, outfall and buried carbon steel piping shall be designed in accordance with ALP-EPC-00000-EL-CAL-0005 (Cathodic Protection Design) for a design life of 30 years, with the current density and anode mass based on the seawater data of this report and on the coating breakdown factors of the coating specification.
